messages:
Anna: quick intake — onboarding kestrel-11b (hf:cobalt/kestrel-11b). Need perf + quant prioritized for chat/assistant workloads. Target p95 latency < 320ms @ batch=1, throughput goal ~300 tok/s. Please include ctx sweep up to 4096 and int8 smoke. @Ben can you reserve infra?
Ben: ack. I'll reserve gpu-dedicated:gpool3 for a 1h slot tomorrow 10:00 PT. What's the QPS target for the baseline?
Mira: propose priority order: 1) FP16 baseline (latency+throughput) 2) ctx sweep [512,1024,2048,4096] 3) batch sweep bs=[1,2,4,8] 4) int8 quant smoke + quality regression on onboard eval set 5) cold-start / kv-cache warmup measurements.
Ryan: I'll take int8 smoke. What's our acceptance criteria for quality? we usually limit ppl delta < 2% or gen-metric drop <1%.
Sofia: add streaming metrics (p50/p95 token latency), and first-token cold-start p50/p95. Also capture memory/VRAM usage at each config.
Mira: bench command for reproducibility (use harness v0.9):
```bash
python run_bench.py \
  --model hf:cobalt/kestrel-11b \
  --seq_lens 512,1024,2048,4096 \
  --batch_sizes 1,2,4,8 \
  --quant_modes none,int8 \
  --metrics latency,throughput,mem,streaming_latency \
  --warmup_steps 20 \
  --samples 200 \
  --out results/kestrel_bench.csv
```
Anna: eval set lives at gs://redwood-evals/kestrel/onboard/prompts_v1.jsonl. Use eval_quality.py for regression checks.
Mira: quality eval snippet:
```bash
python eval_quality.py --pred preds.jsonl --ref prompts_v1.jsonl --metrics ppl,bleu,rouge --thresholds "ppl:2.0,bleu:1.0"
```
perf-bot: created job kestrel-baseline-1918765432 on gpu-dedicated/gpool3 — <http://ci/jobs/1234|view job> :white_check_mark:
Ben: infra note — int8 path depends on kernel build v2.3. If kernel missing, fallback to fp16 path. Ryan, include fallback in your run.
Ryan: will run int8 smoke + fallback. I'll push logs to results/int8_smoke/ and tag the PR.
Mira: quick checklist for thread:
- [ ] baseline FP16 latency + throughput
- [ ] ctx sweep 512 / 1024 / 2048 / 4096
- [ ] batch sweep 1 / 2 / 4 / 8
- [ ] int8 smoke + quality check (ppl/bleu/rouge)
- [ ] cold-start first-token p50/p95 and kv-warmup profile
- [ ] upload raw CSVs + perf dashboard link + short writeup
Anna: I'll own the rollup doc and perf writeup. Assigning owners: Ryan=int8 smoke + quality, Ben=infra slot + kernel check, Mira=bench harness + ctx/batch sweeps, Sofia=cold-start metrics. ETA: EOD +2 days for initial sweep.
Ben: ack.
Anna: thanks all :rocket:
Mira: one more ask — capture tokenization overhead separately (tokenize time per request) so we can separate model vs tokenizer latencies.
Sofia: noted. I'll add tokenizer timer in harness.
Anna: perfect. We'll reconvene after initial runs and sync on any regressions. @perf-bot please post results when job completes.
